subject: Greenline Health — Renewal & portal re-onboarding for expanded capacity
messages:
From: Alex Morales <alex.morales@greenlinehealth.com>

Cc: procurement@greenlinehealth.com
Date: Sat, 14 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor re-onboarding + renewal / capacity increase (renewal 2028-08-01)

Hi Karthik,

Quick note from procurement at Greenline — our renewal window is coming up (annual term ends 2028-08-01) and we're planning to increase committed capacity from ~4k inference units/day to ~10k/day for the upcoming year. Before we can finalize PO and sign the updated SOW we need Redwood to complete our vendor re-onboarding in the new procurement portal (launched last quarter).

Portal checklist includes:
- vendor registration confirmation (new T&Cs, data residency checkbox)
- updated W9 on file
- SSO / SAML metadata for enterprise SSO
- acceptance of the procurement portal billing terms (Net 45)

Can you confirm who on your side will coordinate the portal steps? We also need a revised SOW with the new capacity and a pricing breakdown for commit tiers (monthly commit, burst pricing, and overage). Susan Kim (legal) will review pricing + term changes.

I've attached our PO template for reference. If we can get the SOW and onboarding completed within two weeks we can align the renewal date without service interruption.

Thanks,
Alex Morales
Sr. Procurement Manager
Greenline Health
(Attachment: Greenline_PO_Template.xlsx)

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and the template. We're ready to move quickly on this.

Plan proposal:
1) I'll lead the portal re-registration and provide SAML metadata and our vendor questionnaire answers by EOD Wednesday (2028-07-18).
2) Marissa (cc'd) will deliver a redlined SOW draft with updated commit tiers and a pricing appendix by Tuesday 2028-07-19.
3) Ben (cc'd) will prepare an invoice flow for Net 45 and confirm PO acceptance process.
4) Once Greenline confirms terms, we'll send DocuSign for signature and attach the updated W9.

Quick asks: please confirm the PO recipient name & billing address exactly as it should appear on your PO, and whether there are any additional compliance questionnaires beyond the portal (SOC 2 attestation copy, or security addenda).

I drafted a preliminary SOW (attached) that assumes a monthly committed baseline of 300k tokens/day (approx 9k inferences/day) with a 10% commit discount and a capped overage rate. Marissa will expand the table with month-by-month commit pricing.

Thanks — we can hop on a 20-min call if that helps.

Best,

Subject: Re: Vendor re-onboarding + renewal / capacity increase (pricing notes)

Looping in pricing details and the proposed commit tiers. Alex — I'm sharing the high-level numbers here so procurement can validate against budget. Detailed price appendix attached.

High-level pricing (draft):
- Committed baseline: 300k tokens/day (~9k inferences/day) — $0.012 / 1k tokens (10% trimmed list discount applied)
- Monthly minimum spend = $108k
- Overage: $0.017 / 1k tokens up to burst cap
- Burst capacity: configurable up to 18k inf/day at blended rate we'd specify in appendix
- Term changes: 12-month renewal, auto-renew unless 60-days prior notice

If Greenline confirms a tiered ramp (e.g., 3 months at 6k/day then ramp to 10k/day) we can model a prorated commit for Q1.

Action items for Alex / procurement: confirm desired baseline, billing address, and whether they require Redwood to accept any additional security controls documented in the portal.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Pricing_Appendix_GL_v1.xlsx)
